source_facts: ConnectionState.SupportsDatagrams exposes Remote and Local independently.
Remote is true iff the peer advertised datagram support.
Local is true iff Config.EnableDatagrams enabled local support.
The integration test executes all four server/client enable combinations.
HTTP/3 source states that if datagram support is enabled on our side as well as on the server side, negotiation is expected at both transport and HTTP/3 layers.
